usedFor: ZenCommerce runs the store, and Google Drive shares a file when “New Order Created” runs “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in ZenCommerce, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new order can go out with a link to its invoice or download.

watchOut: “Order Updated” and “Order Status Paid” can also fire for one order, so a share could repeat.
